name: Pendant of Shadow
summary: At the Tower of Ilgalar, Morganth carries the Pendant of Shadow as he pursues the Scythe of Elune. Theocritus wants the talisman brought to the Tower of Azora as proof Morganth has been slain.

sections.title: Token of a Dark Warlock
sections.body: Morganth, a rogue warlock, holds the Pendant of Shadow at the Tower of Ilgalar. He sought the mysteries of the Scythe of Elune, an ancient relic of immense and volatile power. Theocritus feared the havoc Morganth might unleash upon the Redridge Mountains and the kingdom of Stormwind. The mage sent adventurers to infiltrate Ilgalar, end Morganth's plotting, and take the talisman as proof of his demise.

faq.q: Where do I find the Pendant of Shadow?
aliases: how to get pendant of shadow
faq.answer: Morganth carries the pendant at the top of the Tower of Ilgalar in northeastern Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: Who wants the Pendant of Shadow?
faq.answer: Theocritus wants the talisman brought to him at the Tower of Azora in eastern Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Why does Theocritus need this pendant?
faq.answer: Theocritus needs the pendant as proof Morganth has been slain and his pursuit of the dangerous Scythe of Elune has ended.

faq.q: What threat did Morganth pose with the pendant?
faq.answer: Morganth sought the Scythe of Elune. Theocritus feared the warlock would unleash catastrophic power across Redridge and the surrounding kingdom if he secured the artifact.

angles.text: As a mage, recovering the talisman for Theocritus shows the responsibility mages bear to stop reckless rogue spellcasters who threaten the realm.
As a warlock, Morganth shows the peril of drawing the Tower of Azora's scrutiny while pursuing volatile, forbidden artifacts like the Scythe of Elune.
